summary: Identifies the assigned optical input receiving the remote protection information.
description: Identifies the assigned optical input receiving the remote protection information. A protection communication interface carries information between circuit ends or couples a communication signal to a primary line. Its signal path is different from the power-current path even when both use part of the same installation.

In a switchyard line bay, carrier-coupling equipment can connect a protection communication terminal to the transmission conductor. Fiber-based protection uses another physical path but still needs named endpoints and channel supervision. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Remote optical data” at the input and “Local protection receive path” at the output. Endpoint identity must match the configured scheme.
